complex-number-argument-bash.last_note: Final gate passed: independently re-derived every symbolic claim (eq1/eq2/eq3, l2-elimination, cubic locus X, eq2_num, closing identity (‡), D!=0/D2!=0 proofs) from scratch in fresh sympy, and confirmed the new Master-Fact orientation argument is non-circular and load-bearing (not vacuous) across all q>0. Complete rigorous proof; APPROVE, Status: solved.
complex-number-argument-bash.summary: Reduce to (O-N9)⊥BC via Lemma 0; encode all angle equalities as positive-real complex ratios, solve the 1-parameter family in closed form, verify the target identity symbolically via sympy.

homothety-doubling-target.summary: Reformulate OM=ON as O'B=O'C for O'=2O-A (homothety ratio 2 at A); same algebraic content as Lemma 0's target, relocated to a B,C-relative frame via K'=2K-A, L'=2L-A. Bet that this frame makes the angle-condition algebra shorter; admittedly may be redundant with other computational approaches.

nine-point-locus-two-position.last_note: Load-bearing Lemma B (O affine in a reparametrization, by analogy to IMO SL 2023 G5) is numerically refuted across ~15 reparametrizations plus a general Möbius model on two triangles; no substitute two-position mechanism found, so this architecture cannot complete as designed. Salvaged a general, certified O-free circumcenter lemma as byproduct.
nine-point-locus-two-position.summary: Reduce to (O-N9)⊥BC via Lemma 0; parametrize (K,L) by θ, claim O(θ) affine under a reparametrization (SL2023G5-style), pin down by two special positions. Load-bearing Lemma B (affineness) unproven.

spiral-similarity-radical-axis.last_note: Exhaustive scan of all 70 four-point subsets of {A,B,C,M,N,K,L,O} finds none concyclic along the family; independently re-confirmed by reviewer on a third triangle (MNKL concyclicity det ~0.03-0.05, decisively nonzero, while OM-ON ~2e-10). Concyclicity-among-named-points premise is false; approach cannot work as stated.
spiral-similarity-radical-axis.summary: Reduce to (O-N9)⊥BC via Lemma 0; look for concyclic quadruples among {B,C,M,N,K,L} forced by conditions (ii),(iii), then finish via radical axis of two equal circles. Existence of the concyclicity is an unverified numerical existence-check gating the whole approach.

symmetric-vector-decomposition-sigma.last_note: Proved (and reviewer independently re-verified in sympy with free variables) that the naive sigma-antisymmetry mechanism is a content-free tautology holding for all points with zero use of hypotheses (i)-(iii); cannot force T=0. Core mechanism refuted; sigma-invariance and vacuity lemmas certified as reusable byproducts only.
symmetric-vector-decomposition-sigma.summary: Reduce to (O-N9)⊥BC via Lemma 0; exploit the B↔C,K↔L,M↔N involution σ that preserves the defining system, aiming to show the BC-component of O-N9 is an antisymmetric expression that telescopes to zero. Mechanism for the cancellation not yet exhibited.
